snippet.title: Njabulo Langa - uBhanyazile feat. Mjikelo (Official Music Video)
snippet.description:
Watch the official music video for “uBhanyazile” by Njabulo Langa featuring Mjikelo, a powerful Maskandi release rooted in Zulu storytelling, traditional guitar rhythms and authentic South African musical expression.

uBhanyazile brings together Njabulo Langa’s heartfelt delivery with Mjikelo’s distinctive contribution, creating a song filled with cultural pride, emotion and the unmistakable sound of modern Maskandi music. The track captures the depth of everyday life, identity and storytelling through powerful vocals and rich traditional influence.

The official music video brings the song’s message to life visually, giving fans a deeper connection to the music, the performance and the cultural spirit behind this collaboration.
